sections.text: The approval step's next job writes exactly these reviews - nothing else: no collection, user or other review is changed, and no asset but the new ones (NEW ASSET: created with that name and STIG, then the scan's answers written as its reviews - the update does not create one that is there by then). Each review is written only if it is still as it was read here (STIG Manager now); one changed since is left, and said. The detail is what the scan found; a review that has a comment keeps it (a finding gets one).
